What is the measure of $∠B$ in the triangle  $△ABC$ above?
question.worked_solution:
Since two sides are congruent, $\overset{―}{AC}≅\overset{―}{CB},$ we conclude that $△ABC$ is isosceles. Consequently, the base angles must have the same measure:

$$
m∠A=m∠B=2x-{9}^{∘}
$$

Now, since the internal angles of any triangle sum to ${180}^{∘},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠A+m∠B+m∠C & ={180}^{∘} \\ (2x-{9}^{∘})+(2x-{9}^{∘})+(4x+{14}^{∘}) & ={180}^{∘} \\ 8x-{4}^{∘} & ={180}^{∘} \\ 8x & ={184}^{∘} \\ x & ={23}^{∘}\,.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, substituting $x={23}^{∘}$ into the equation for the measure of $∠B$ gives

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠B & =m∠A \\  & =2x-{9}^{∘} \\  & =2({23}^{∘})-{9}^{∘} \\  & ={37}^{∘}\,.\end{aligned}
$$

So $m∠B={37}^{∘}.$
